notes.title: Release Notes (v1.0)
notes.notes:
Launch day!!
Wooooh! It took awhile, but the 1.0 release is finally here. After two years in Early Access we finally wrapped it up. You can see the patch notes below, but besides that there were also lots of graphical upgrades and hundreds of bug fixes. Please report any bugs you see with F11 at the main menu.

Thanks to everybody who supported me on the journey, especially my mom. I've added most of the people who helped me play-test into the credits - they were integral to designing the game and I'm very thankful for them.

Patch Notes
[olist]
     Introducing the new Dragon Tamer guild, adding a fresh layer of strategy and power to your arsenal.
     Explore the possibilities with Augments, allowing you to customize your run and enhance your magical abilities.
     Continue your wizardly journey beyond Day 6, facing increasingly formidable enemies with no additional progression.
     Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world with a graphics overhaul that breathes new life into the game.
     Experience re-balanced enemies, especially the final boss, for an even more challenging and rewarding showdown.
[/olist]

Thanks for reading, hope you enjoy the game!

- Keith

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.70 - "Lich Update"
notes.notes:
Winning the Tournament

 New enemy! Meet the lich on day 6.
 Lich comes with unique primary/secondary/homing/ultimate/utility.
 Can now beat the game! Day 6 is the final day. Rewards for doing so coming next patch.

Aesthetic Upgrades

 New art for character portraits.
 Re-worked a bunch of textures for improved visuals.

Quality of Life

 Spell upgrades are now displayed when hovering the upgrade button in adventure mode.
 Can now rest from pre-match screen.
 Now showing relics in pre-match screen.
 Skips player intros for default wizard fights now.

Bug Fixes

 (Sid) Can't print money with controller in spell shop anymore.
 (Sid) Can't go beyond max upgrade level in upgrade shop anymore.
 (Sid) Collecting more than one plant in a match goes towards alchemist quest reward.
 (Sid) Big building no longer blocking view on left-hand side of Overworld.
 Fixed character intros.
 Could make a potion with only one ingredient.
 Mouse no longer disappears in settings menu with local multiplayer.

Balancing

 Changed Aqua's and Vito's secondary moves to do less damage but launch the enemy into the air (for easier combos with their primary moves).
 Nerfed Arcane Whirlpool to die earlier and thus deal less damage overall.
 Nerfed the Slavery Potion to only imprison opponent for 5 seconds (too annoying to fight against).
 Fixed fireball level 3 to actually explode on impact.

notes.title: News on Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello! It's been a couple months since any updates. To be honest, I took most of that time off. I started a new job and was traveling quite a bit, so couldn't find the time for my dear baby WizardPunk. But I'm back at it now, and feeling quite refreshed. Here's what to expect in the next update (probably towards the end of January):

- Will finally be able to win the tournament! There will be a final boss, and probably some adventure mode updates to make the experience more re-playable (I'm thinking the final boss will be on day 6 so it should take about 1-2 hrs for each run).
- Lots more information on spell upgrades (the exact details shown for what is upgraded)
- Lots of nerfs/buffs to particular spells to make everything more balanced. In particular, Aqua's secondary will now be a knock-up, Arc's secondary will be getting nerfed, and there will probably be changes in store for Vito who I think has the weakest kit right now).
- Improved visuals. I recently learned a photoshop trick that I can apply on most of the textures in the game to "normalize" their look, which is part of a plan to make the game much more consistent looking.

And that's about all for now. I've also been working on a small game about cognitive behavioral therapy. If that's interesting to you, feel free to reach out, would love to chat about it. Also, I got rid of the game's discord for now. There wasn't much interest/activity in it, so it wasn't worth the effort/time involved sadly. See you in the next update!

Cheers,
Keith

As always, feedback is much appreciated! Teamwork makes the dream work!

notes.title: Post-vacation, Pre-new-update
notes.notes:
After working for 2 years and however many months on the game I thought I deserved some time off from it - so I took a month off. Celebrated my birthday. Started dreaming up other game concepts (I haven't really allowed myself the chance while working on WP). But I still want to finish WP so I'm going to be slowly returning to it.

What's next?
Hopefully an update in time for Halloween with the Witch's guild.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/e055a5e90ceef22f2a750f1d4d283c3fcb6805e6.png

Can you help?
Yes, by writing a review! I honestly don't care if it's negative at this point - I need to hit a certain amount of reviews before Steam starts showing the game to more people. Beyond that, if you could hit F11 in-game and leave feedback on what you liked or didn't like, that helps me a lot too. Otherwise I'm just making the game that I want to make, instead of the one that you the player wants to be made.

Off for now! Thanks for being apart of this journey.
- Keith

notes.title: Early Access Release - September 1st!
notes.notes:
It's finally here! Two years and four months later, it's almost time to put it in front of the public. And get absolutely devoured by the Steam audience (hopefully not haha but who knows). I'm super happy with where the game is at right now, and I hope people like it. I'm intending to work on the game another six months or so, taking into account all the Early Access feedback. Hopefully this will shape it into a really awesome addition to the indie game world. As a "last post before EA where I will have to be talking really professional about all the changes in the game", I wanted to post some combat pics from over the course of the development.

notes.title: Alpha build release (Oct 2020) for Discord members
notes.notes:
Hello, hello! What a glorious time of year, still in a pandemic and approaching an insane election time in the US! Let us escape from that for a second, and let me tell you what is new with Wizardpunk.

If you just want to play it, you can do so by joining the discord here: https://t.co/X09OVqmY2p?amp=1

Future
We've arrived at a point jusssst before adding a ton of content. One of those is a profession system, so you can choose between Shaman, Witch/Warlock, Beastmaster, and Alchemist. You will get quests from your guild leader and can grow stronger that way. Next will be adding some real dialog and story - starting with the announcer that is walking around the overworld right now. He will be your guide for the tournament and will be the knowledge source. Then all of the characters will have some dynamic dialog like congratulating you for a good match or saying sorry if you barely got out, things like that. Last thing lined up for content is crowd interactions, making them hold up signs of their favorite contestant, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/68ab19a926511238bd3fd99f0b7404f2fc342d18.png

New stuff
Local multiplayer
In versus mode, just change 'AI' to 'Player 2', and choose your input.

 Can play as Skelli, Draggi, and Raijin now
Previously, they were only CPU opponents. Go to versus mode and cycle through the characters to find them.

Homing moves
These moves start on the ground next to you (can't use while in-air), and they automatically try to seek out the opponent.

notes.title: Progress Update (May 2020 - Steam Summer Fest)
notes.notes:
New Enemy - "Raijin"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/a69e9ea0084b9302482e405075dad72479de9ea0.png

Raijin is currently the only non-playable real enemy besides Skelli. I've had some negative feedback about fighting the default "city wizards" all the time, so I'm thinking about having a much larger roster of original characters like this than I originally planned. That should help pad out the brackets such that it's not the same character (with a different colored hat) that you are fighting each time. Would be cool to go a "dragonball" route where you have some mediocre but interesting characters that are unique but weaker in general than characters like Raijin.

Storyboards for Arc & Aqua
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/40e31a56d4dc50ed4b34b43e00063c1f22a06698.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/81aee0d3d815b5808f017c38faf8512f7d514a8a.png

Last time I only had Vito's and Ignissa's done. These are really the only story in the game so far, which I'm not really excited about. Will be adding dialog with other characters soon and working to expand upon these "origin stories" with each character. Hoping to implement a way to take a character in one of two directions. As an example, I'd like to explore a Vito that says "f*ck my temple, I'm going rogue" and then another Vito that stays true to them at all costs. Kind of like in Fable where you can choose evil or good.

New shield move for Vito
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/2b60ee94ebd319d5ed6242ec87cb4424c4149f4f.png

New blink move for Arc
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/ea9728ccc763cd63076af6d295227def143932a6.png

Steam Summer Festival
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/144e08f4881482716c65c9368a563d779cabc0ac.png

This is hopefully going to be really good for the game, as it should put it in front of a bunch of new people, and most importantly get some feedback on if it's fun in it's current state. I wasn't planning to release a demo for a little while longer, so the demo that people will play is not ideal, but I didn't want to pass up so many potential new players. You can't have the demo up before or immediately after, so the demo will be playable from June 9th till June 14th if you want to try it out.

Coming Soon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/0a6d8cb452b5764af3083dec140b01794e89620a.png

I've got this in-game for players to see when they win or lose in adventure mode, and I'm hoping I get some feedback on which ones sound interesting. If you're reading this and have an opinion on the matter, please message me on Twitter! (@keiththomasdev) This will help decide the direction I take from here on out.

Besides this list, I have three main areas of focus:
[olist]
 Further improving the combat with things like:
   a. "Heat-seeking" shots that will eliminate degenerate gameplay like sitting behind a wall.
   b. Environmental hazards (accomplishing the same thing)
 More stuff to do while in town, to take a break from fighting. Maybe some minigames, or maybe 
    just a bunch of people to talk to, probably a bit of both.
 More of a focus on the "tournament" part, so having an announcer and a crowd and events in 
    town when ending a bracket.
[/olist]

Thanks for reading.
- Keith

notes.notes:
Updates

Work-in-Progress

Working on a "tournament bracket" system instead of the old adventure progression. The plan is to allow selection of a path and reward players for fighting harder wizards in the first round. It's easier to wait to fight them until the final round because you'll have earned a bit more mana (the currency) and can buy a couple more upgrades.

New WIP
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/5ede8f35ccb80b151812011848461fc7c4487181.png
Old style
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/13f2ea21577322a0a09ba7c25673e3b8689ce7b8.png

Working with an artist (@identikit_bode) who is creating some super stylish comic panels for each character. I'm planning to tell the whole story this way. Start/end and maybe some interspersed through the middle. Only have Vito's and Ignissa's right now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/5c734815c7df9367e4ad6e35f8efe222e170c2a1.png

Next Steps

Yo, I thought you were releasing a demo?
Yeah .. still working on it. I've done a ton of graphical upgrades but not a ton of gameplay upgrades, so it isn't much further along than the last itch.io demo from November. At least gameplay-wise. The bracket work is towards that goal though, so hoping to have a solid demo in a couple months. Plan for the demo is: you fight a couple "bosses" in the adventure mode and can buy some meaningful upgrades for your wizard and your spells.

What are you working on?
Sooo, I've got the following things on my to-do list:

 Finish bracket system
 One more building - a "spell mechanic" who upgrades your spells
 Finish controller support (only half works right now)
 SFX for random things I forgot like walking and rolling and UI clicks
 Some way to see all your upgrades and health and stuff in the overworld, some sort of "character" screen
 Local multiplayer - this is a big one and should be a stepping stone towards online multiplayer which is not a for sure thing, but I want to investigate it


Thanks for reading! I post more on my twitter if you want to follow there, but I'll drop the larger posts here.

- Keith
